column8: List Minidregg.Kernel.ResourceMoneyWire.Entry → Minidregg.Kernel.ResourceMoneyWire.ApplicationBatch → Prop := fun entries batch => (List.map Minidregg.Kernel.ResourceMoneyWire.Entry.account entries).Nodup ∧ (∀ entry ∈ entries, entry.consent.positions.Nodup ∧ ∀ position ∈ entry.consent.positions, Minidregg.Kernel.ResourceMoneyWire.PositionSource batch entry position) ∧ (∀ position ∈ List.finRange batch.operations.length, ∃ entry ∈ entries, ↑position ∈ entry.consent.positions ∧ batch.operations[position].posting.source = entry.account) ∧ ∀ operation ∈ batch.operations, ∃ entry ∈ entries, operation.posting.destination = entry.account

Minidregg.Kernel.ResourceMoneyWire.ApplicationBatch → Minidregg.Kernel.ResourceMoneyWire.Entry → ℕ → Prop := fun batch entry position => match batch.operations[position]? with | Option.none => False | Option.some operation => operation.posting.source = entry.account
